en: What is the impact of standby power consumption?
Standby vs. OFF – Hidden Energy Consumption
Compare power usage in different device states

Many entertainment devices such as televisions, game consoles, speakers and streaming boxes continue to use electricity even when they appear to be switched off. This hidden electricity consumption is called standby power or vampire energy. Although the amount of energy used by one device is small, millions of devices operating in standby mode every day result in a significant waste of energy and unnecessary greenhouse gas emissions.
Understanding standby consumption helps us become more responsible energy users and supports environmental sustainability.
Electronic devices often remain partially active when switched off. They may continue to power clocks, remote-control receivers, internet connections or software updates.
